title: dryopteris rupestris
intro: Dryopteris rupestris, commonly known as Wallis's fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the division Pteridophyta, characterized by its fronds and spores. The health benefits of Wallis's fern include its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce oxidative stress and inflammation in the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing.
